releaseNotes: Personal Calendar and Smart Reminder now support selectable ringtone volume (0–100%), screen-on time matched to the chosen ringtone duration, Snooze intervals (2/5/10/15/20/30 minutes), repeat limits (off/3/5/10), and ringtone duration (10/20/30 seconds or 1/2/5 minutes). Existing ringtone choice, calendar recurrence, notifications, notes, photos, PIN data, and app identity remain preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Diary features and design updated online. Local notes and photos remain on this device.
